 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 26, 2026, 06:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print The Moon's second day in Aries keeps Aquarius moving forward this Monday. Now in Bharani, a nakshatra linked with endurance and carrying responsibility, the Moon in your third house turns yesterday’s spark into staying power. Kartik begins today, a month that rewards daily discipline, which suits a sign ruled by Shani. Shani itself, retrograde in your second, is writing the closing chapter of your Sade Sati. Bharani in the Third House
 The third house governs effort and short-term goals. Bharani carries the image of a vessel bearing life, so it supports finishing heavy tasks rather than starting light ones. Watch Your Name Is Secretly Blocking Success & Money? The Numerology Formula for Success | Ft. Roohi Jain Take up the job you have been avoiding, whether a pending application or a hard conversation with a sibling, and see it through today. Sade Sati in Its Last Stretch
 For more than six years, Shani has tested Aquarius through your twelfth, first and now second houses. The lessons in patience and plain speech are nearly learned. Shani turns direct in December and leaves Pisces in mid-2027, so relief grows month by month. Courage now rests on that experience. Kartik Discipline
 Kartik is traditionally kept with small daily vows. Choose one for the month, such as a dawn walk or an evening lamp, and keep it without fail. Shani honours promises kept to yourself as much as those made to others. The Ninth House and Rahu
 Long-distance plans stay paused while Mercury and Venus move backward in your ninth. Rahu on your sign may urge risky bravado. Channel the courage into finishing tasks instead. Do’s for Today
 Finish one heavy task you have been avoiding. Choose one daily vow for Kartik. Don’ts for Today
 Avoid risky bravado driven by Rahu. Do not start light tasks before finishing the heavy one. Shani Remedy for Today
 Help a young person prepare for a job interview. Sponsor the camp fee for a student joining an NCC or trekking programme.
